facts.fact: Interior ministry director general Redouane Mahfoudi announced that digital identity, based on the biometric electronic ID card and accessed by citizens securely from their mobile phone, would start to be handed to citizens before the end of 2024.

systems.platform: mobile phone, biometric electronic ID card

DZA.note: No link between the civil register and the ID system is described.
Only a draft civil status bill on digitisation, examined by the government on 3 April 2024; no digital register is stated.
No count or share of people holding a national ID is given.
No number at birth is mentioned.
The document says nothing on who operates, maintains or owns the ID system.
No public register keyed on the ID number is named.

facts.fact: Ministry of the Interior official Redouane Mahfoudi says the digital identity rests on the biometric information carried in Algeria's biometric electronic identity card.

DZA.note: Only a draft civil status bill on digitisation is mentioned; no registration system is described.
